Hi Karthik,

Hope you're doing well. Brightlane's security team is running a scoped review ahead of our procurement sign-off and we need a short packet of personnel evidence related to onboarding/offboarding controls. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday, May 5?

- High-level training matrix for customer-facing and infra teams (training name, frequency, last completed date).

If any of these are PII-sensitive, we can accept redacted PDFs or hashed identifiers. Also confirm whether ongoing training is mandatory and the cadence for refresher training.

Thanks — Elena
